title: extcap: Have the interface toolbar send messages to a queue
description:
Instead of having the Interface Toolbar open its own copy of the
file descriptor and having a mutex, have all the writing done in
the extcap.c as well. Do some proper reference counting on the
queue instead of hoping that the interface_opts pointer won't
be deleted.

Also open the control out non-blocking and repeatedly retry,
which fixes #18501 on non-Windows. (It was already fine on Windows.)

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
